title: Characterizations of independence between order statistics and rank indicators
summary: We study the independence between an order statistic and its corresponding rank indicator for independent nonnegative random variables. A general characterization is established through a probability measure obtained by reweighting the distribution of a single observation according to its conditional probability of occupying a prescribed rank. This framework yields explicit expressions for the associated weighting functions and conditional distributions, as well as distribution-free measures of departure from independence based on Kolmogorov and Wasserstein distances.
